title: Brand mark · Background color
slide_intent: Show how the value and local texture of a background affect recognition. A busy patch of an image can obscure letters even when its average tone seems suitable.
strategic_value: Choosing an appropriate mark version can preserve its readability across white paper, solid fields and photographic work.
demonstration: The upper examples pair acceptable placements with crossed-out alternatives. A white-to-black scale below marks the 30% boundary and shows dark and reversed program marks.
practical_value: Reserve the color mark for white. On a low-contrast image area or solid tone use a dark single-color mark through 30% black and the white version on darker tones.

content_islands.name: Treatment instructions
content_islands.spec: Separate the rules for color, single-color and photographic backgrounds in the left column.

content_islands.name: Background comparisons
content_islands.spec: Place the approved examples above the corresponding crossed-out examples. Show white, dark, quiet and busy fields.

content_islands.name: Value scale
content_islands.spec: Run the horizontal value ramp across the lower field. Label the threshold and place opposite mark treatments at the ends.
